sweep.text: Eligible funds at each bank may be automatically swept into one or more sweep network banks. Cash App says customers currently cannot opt out of or exclude sweep network banks.

ifFintechFails.text: FDIC pass-through insurance only covers the failure of an FDIC-insured bank, not Cash App.
